name: mac-purificator
description: A Mac cleaner (Mac Purificator) that explains why each item can go, and asks when it is not sure.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.test: npm run build:main && node --test dist/main/tests/scanner.test.js dist/main/tests/apps.test.js dist/main/tests/hidden.test.js dist/main/tests/unusedapps.test.js dist/main/tests/organize.test.js dist/main/tests/sysinfo.test.js dist/main/tests/busy.test.js dist/main/tests/library.test.js dist/main/tests/selfupdate.test.js dist/main/tests/libbrowse.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && bash scripts/make-icns.sh && electron-packager . "Mac Purificator" --platform=darwin --arch=$(node -p "process.arch") --out=release --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.kellyzicoder.macpurificator --ignore="^/(src|tests|demo|docs|release|scripts|node_modules/\\.cache)($|/)" --ignore="^/(tsconfig.*|vite.config.ts|README.md)$"
